from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_functions import (
    get_HLT_factory,
    get_njet,
    get_nbtag,
)
from pocket_coffea.parameters.cuts import cuts as default_cuts
from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_functions import PackedSelection

# Initialize cuts for 2018 semileptonic ttbar analysis
cuts_2018 = {
    "skim": [
        # HLT trigger selection for semileptonic dataset
        get_HLT_factory(
            "semileptonic",
            dataset_name="semileptonic"
        ),
    ],
    "preselection": [
        # At least 4 jets with pT > 30 GeV from JetGood collection
        get_njet(
            4,
            pt_min=30,
            collection="JetGood",
            custom_cut=None,
        ),
        # At least 2 b-tagged jets
        get_nbtag(
            2,
            wps="medium",
            collection="JetGood",
        ),
    ],
}

# Merge with default cuts if needed
cuts_2018.update(default_cuts)

# Export configuration
__all__ = ["cuts_2018"]
